title: Elk Cove 2015 Clay Court Pinot Noir (Chehalem Mountains)

description: This substantial, powerfully styled Pinot Noir is layered with tart, punchy red fruit. That rich core is laced with brown sugar, coffee, caramel and cola streaks. It was aged in 10% new French oak.
title: Ghost Hill 2014 Bayliss-Bower Vineyard Pinot Noir

description: Sourced from the estate's Bayliss-Bower vineyard, this reserve is a barrel selection that saw a touch more new oak (17%) than the regular bottling. It's tannic and a bit chewy, with lush black cherry fruit. Subtle cola and graphite suggestions add complexity.
title: Ghost Hill 2014 Prospector's Reserve Pinot Noir

description: Ostentatiously ripe, this full-bodied wine hardly hides its richness. It's generous and packed with fruitiness. The acidity and the tighter texture are backdrops to this great burst of fruit. Drink now.
title: Gitton Père et Fils 2015 Les Montachins  (Sancerre)

description: It's hard to believe such a wine can come from the Barossa, a region known for size and richness. But this is part of a new wave of Aussie Shiraz—medium in body and silky in style, with moderate alcohol levels. Healthy doses of oak impart notes of hickory smoke, cedar and vanilla to the plum fruit. Drink now–2025.
title: Maverick 2014 Breechens Shiraz (Barossa)

description: A brick red in color, this bottling of an usually blended variety is quite compelling and delicious, starting with the intriguing nose of pine needle and smashed red plum. The palate picks up Mourvèdre's leathery hallmark, which gives rustic elegance to the red cherry and pine needle spice.
title: Waterloo 2015 The Harvest of Beulah Land Mourvèdre (Paso Robles)

description: Spice and saffron notes introduce this lavishly fruity sun-kissed wine. Pristine stone-fruit and pineapple flavors are delightfully plump but balanced in sweetness and jolted by shocks of lemon-lime acidity. This is gorgeously penetrating through a long lingering finish.
designation: Cardinal Cusanus Stiftswein Wehlener Sonnenuhr Spätlese
title: Weingut Stiftung St. Nikolaus-Hospital 2015 Cardinal Cusanus Stiftswein Wehlener Sonnenuhr Spätlese Riesling (Mosel)

description: Dense and rich on the palate, this shows the concentration achieved in this coastal location. Snap pea, pineapple and nectarine elements combine for a harmonious whole that lingers on the finish, picking up more austere hints of wet stone. Drink now.
title: Yealands 2016 S1 Single Block Awatere Valley Sauvignon Blanc (Marlborough)

description: Extracted, grapy aromas suggest raisin and prune but this wine is not overtly overripe. In the mouth, it is grabby and a bit raisiny. Rich, heady flavors of mocha, fig and prune finish with chunky weight. Drink through 2020.
title: Zolo 2012 Black Malbec (Mendoza)

description: Stainless steel fermented and bone-dry, this leesy, creamy wine balances lime, lemon and grapefruit flavors. Those citrus notes roll through richer dried apricot tones and into a balanced, persistent finish. Drink now and over the next two years.
title: Abacela 2016 Viognier (Umpqua Valley)

description: Consistent with the 2014 Confero, this blends multiple clones from five different vineyards. Its details are sharp, framing taut red fruit with a vein of licorice before resolving into dusty tannins. It delivers excellent length, muscle and definition.
title: Aberrant Cellars 2015 Confero Pinot Noir (Willamette Valley)

description: This is one of the entry-level ranges from this top producer. The wine is sophisticated. It has a strong mineral texture and fine ripe citrus and pear fruits shot through with acidity. With its finishing fruitiness, this is already an attractive wine, although it will be better from 2018.
title: Alphonse Mellot 2016 La Moussière  (Sancerre)

description: Wood-aged and ripe, this is a full, generous blend of Alicante Bouschet, Touriga Franca and Touriga Nacional. Full of rounded black fruits and firm tannins, it needs further aging to bring out the full suppleness and richness. Drink from 2019.
title: Casa Agricola Alexandre Relvas 2015 Monte dos Amigos Premium Red (Alentejano)

description: Mature and with swathes of ripe fruit, this is a concentrated wine. Tannins give a firm core to the velvet-textured blackberry fruits. Richness and a sense of power are aided by the spice, pepper and dry aftertaste. Drink from 2018.
designation: Monte Cascas Grande Reserva Old Vines
title: Casca Wines 2012 Monte Cascas Grande Reserva Old Vines Red (Douro)

description: A blend of Merlot (50%), Cabernet Franc (40%) and Cabernet Sauvignon (10%), this aromatic wine brings aromas of funk, earth, truffle, fire pit, dried peat, herb and cherry. The flavors are soft, silky and refined, showing a sense of grace—a very pretty expression of a Bordeaux-style blend.
title: Cayuse 2014 Flying Pig Red (Walla Walla Valley (OR))

description: Just slightly off-dry, this excellent bottle mixes its ripe lemon, orange and papaya fruit with breakfast tea-like flavors. Its acidity is ample enough to keep the sweetness at bay, making it a fine, all-purpose wine that should please a wide variety of palates.
title: Chehalem 2016 Three Vineyard Riesling (Willamette Valley)

description: Richly rewarding as a berry bramble, this wine is bright and refreshing within a softly layered texture of ripeness and a full body. Cinnamon and leather saddle complement the heady fruit.
title: Crux 2014 Zinfandel (Russian River Valley)

description: This is a powerful Pinot Noir that jumps toward the nose with black raspberry and other dark fruits as well as strong cedar and caramel aromas. Thick raspberry and rounded cherry flavors show on the sip, which enjoys strong and compelling spice notes of clove, star anise and even some licorice. Pair with steak.
title: Diora 2015 Le Petite Grace Pinot Noir (Monterey)

description: This private selection is nicely structured, pitting clean raspberry fruit against tight tannins. Those strong components are accented with touches of cola and earth and a subtle undercurrent of barrel toast.
title: Dois Irmãos 2015 Two Brothers' Private Selection Pinot Noir (Willamette Valley)

description: Prunelard (or Prunelart) is a Gaillac grape that had almost disappeared. Revived by a few enterprising producers, it produces a distinctly fruity, aromatic wine. This bottling's firm edge of tannins and juicy acidity contribute structure and intense fruitiness. Still bursting with youth, it should be aged for another year. Drink from 2018.
title: Domaine des Terrisses 2015 Le Monde en Parle Prunelard (Vin de France)

description: This wine comes from a single vineyard on the south bank of the Vienne river. It is ripe, perfumed and generously rich with concentrated blackberry fruit and balanced tannins. Some wood aging has broadened the wine rather than adding flavor. The wine could age another year with noticeable benefit, so drink from 2018.
title: Domaine Dozon 2015 Clos du Saut au Loup  (Chinon)

description: This is technically a white wine but with eyes closed it could be taken for a big red. The color is orange, the aromas are earthy and extremely citric, while the flavors are laser focused on orange and lemon zest. Acidity and tannins coat the palate and give it a mouth-puckering grip. It's not for the meek, but the adventurous will love it.
title: Donkey & Goat 2015 Stone Crusher Roussanne (El Dorado)

description: This juicy coastal wine offers medium acidity and a lightness on the palate. It is a well-crafted, balanced effort, exuding wet stone, lemon zest, apple and white flower aromas and flavors.
title: Flowers 2015 Chardonnay (Sonoma Coast)

description: From a site adjacent to the Pines vineyard, this rare Oregon Zinfandel deftly melds toast, sweet spice, buttered nut, espresso and black cherry flavors. It's big, bold, dark and delicious, with more lift than its high alcohol might suggest.
title: Heart Catcher 2013 Volcano Ridge Vineyard Zinfandel (Columbia Gorge (OR))

description: This oak-aged wine is rich and intense. It is a ripe blend of Arinto and Viognier, with a pinch of Chardonnay. Together they give the wine its perfumed character, spiced and with a beautiful streak of acidity. Although ready to drink, the wine is young and will be better from 2018.
title: Herdade da Malhadinha Nova 2015 Maladinha Branco White (Alentejano)

description: A toasty wood-smoke aroma meets firm, vivid and rather tart fruit flavors in this medium-bodied, elegant and cerebral wine. It has firm structure and good balance, as fine-grained tannins and tangy acidity support the red-cherry and raspberry flavors.
title: Hirsch 2014 San Andreas Fault Pinot Noir (Sonoma Coast)

description: This shows the superhigh alcohol that Zins from this vineyard often achieve. It's bone dry, but it has a heaviness and heat that make it Port-like, with black currant, prune and dark chocolate flavors.
title: Rosenblum 2010 Monte Rosso Vineyard Zinfandel (Sonoma Valley)

description: Made using grapes from the celebrated Montegradella cru, this easy red offers quality fruit aromas of black cherry, cassis and jammy blackberry. On the finish, a spice note and a light shade of tobacco are recognizable.
title: Sartori 2009 Vigneti di Montegradella  (Valpolicella Classico Superiore)

description: This is soft and gentle, with easy berry, herb, cola and sandalwood flavors. Drink now, as this is about as good as it will ever be.
title: Sebastiani 2008 Merlot (Sonoma County)

description: The attack on this light-bodied sipper is unabashedly fruity, with loads of ripe peach and nectarine flavors. It balances out quite nicely with zippy acidity and a dry, steely finish. This is a noteworthy addition to the growing line up of Finger Lakes Grüner Veltliner.
title: Stony Lonesome 2011 Estate Reserve Grüner Veltliner (Finger Lakes)

description: Produced by one of Valpolicella's best producers of Amarone, this offers a crisp citrus aroma followed by notes of peach, white almond and pear. It is crisp, compact and medium in length.
title: Tedeschi 2011 Capitel Tenda  (Soave Classico)

description: This is the winery's fruitier, more accessible Syrah. Full bodied and fruity, it's fine introduction to Terre Rouge wines.
title: Terre Rouge 2009 Les Cotes de l'Ouest Syrah (California)

description: This shows smooth, varietally correct fruit, however, the flavors are a bit muted. The softness is pleasant, but takes the lift out of the wine, finishing with drying tannins.
title: Three Rivers 2009 Seven Hills Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon (Walla Walla Valley (WA))

description: This is roasted, savory and spicy up front, with solid berry aromas. It feels crisp and fresh, with a blend of cherry, strawberry and herb flavors. It's spicy, lively, fresh and clean on the finish.
title: Vaza 2008 Crianza  (Rioja)

description: This is packed tightly with candied fruit, cassis, tar, licorice and dark caramel notes. It shows its age and probably should be consumed within the next year or two. The palate offers a clean, polished feel.
title: Villa Spinosa 2006 Anteprima  (Amarone della Valpolicella Classico)

description: This spicy white blend mixes Viognier, Sémillon and Pinot Gris. Notes of green berries and other green fruits—notably banana—all have an herbal underpinning.
title: Airfield Estates 2011 Flygirl White (Yakima Valley)

description: Rich, deliciously fruity and ripe, this combines warmth with a more mineral undertow that cuts through the palate, creating a wine that is refreshing and mouth-filling. It would be worth aging for two years or more.
title: Albert Bichot 2010 Domaine Long-Depaquit  (Chablis)

description: This is an attractively structured wine, with ripe strawberry and smoky wood flavors. The fruit continues through to the soft finish, which is laced with acidity and a firm tannic core.
title: André Guichot 2010 La Maladière Premier Cru  (Santenay)

description: From Dominio de la Vega, this dark Bobal has a rubbery, chunky, dark-fruited nose. The full-bodied palate is round and lusty, with extracted plum, berry and chocolate flavors. The finish is long, with drying tannins.
title: Artemayor NV IV Bobal (Utiel-Requena)

description: Forward and fruity, with loads of sweet cherry flavor, this tasty Cabernet Franc boasts shades of briar, cracked pepper and savory dried herbs that add subtlety and depth. Ripe and full in body, it's balanced by puckery acidity and soft, rippling tannins.
title: Atwater 2008 Cabernet Franc (Finger Lakes)

description: There's lots of forward raspberry, cherry and pomegranate fruit in this soft, lush wine. Oak brings an additional layer of richness. It's delicious—like toast spread with butter and jam—but a little one-dimensional. However, it's a wonderful dimension to explore now.
title: Baxter 2009 Pinot Noir (Anderson Valley)

description: This shows both the finesse of the Anderson Valley and the '09 vintage that was so kind to coastal Pinot Noir. It has rich flavors of cherry jam and ripe pomegranate, with fine acidity, but there's an excessive oakiness that gives it a toothpicky sweetness.
title: Baxter 2009 Run Dog Vineyard Pinot Noir (Anderson Valley)

description: Savory, juicy, refreshing and textured, this has a crisp green-fruit feel, and is full of bright fruit flavors. The finish continues to express the lively, tight character of the wine.
title: Bernard Defaix 2010  Chablis

description: Forward and fruity, this is a tight, tart wine with a jumble of berry and bramble flavors. It's peppery, spicy, but don't look for too much complexity. Gulp it down for the enjoyable quaffer that it's meant to be.
title: Board Track Racer 2010 The Vincent Red (Washington)

description: This is a bit lighter than the previous vintage, offering tart red-berry fruit, accented with a note of fresh herb. The chocolaty barrel accents smooth out the midpalate and lead into a pleasant finish.
title: Waterbrook 2009 Reserve Merlot (Columbia Valley (WA))

description: Strong scents and flavors of oak and spice mask the fruit. It feels a bit flat on the palate, as if heading toward early oxidation. The oak and butterscotch flavors carry through onto the finish. Two bottles tasted.
title: Waterbrook 2010 Reserve Chardonnay (Columbia Valley (WA))

description: A strong streak of pure vanilla highlights the flavors here. The fruit tastes of fresh-picked strawberries. This is 100% Syrah made from estate-grown fruit.
title: Hyatt 2009 Syrah (Rattlesnake Hills)

description: This has concentrated apple, mango and lime skin notes that are shaded with tones of smoke, crushed chalk and white pepper. Round and rich on the palate, with a mouthfilling viscosity, it's balanced with a flash of lemony acidity and a tingling tea-leaf astringency.
title: Inspire Moore 2011 Peace Pinot Gris (Finger Lakes)

description: A fruity wine from the lesser known Fixin appellation, this has strawberry fruit, soft tannins and a warm, rich texture. The acidity brings out a bright side to this approachable offering.
title: Bouchard Aîné & Fils 2009 Cuvée Signature La Mazière  (Fixin)

description: The nose is spicy and enticing, with highlights of pineapple and grapefruit. On the palate, the fruit is tart but nicely balanced, with defining acidity and a finishing pat of butter.
title: Bridgman 2010 Chardonnay (Columbia Valley (WA))

description: Dark and spicy, this has ripe fruit, prune, currant and blackberry aromas that are followed by clove, cardamom and black pepper notes. The mouthfeel is medium in terms of length and build.
title: Cantina Negrar 2010 Le Roselle  (Valpolicella Classico Superiore Ripasso)

description: Rich fruit aromas of yellow apple flesh, mealy pear and banana lead the bouquet, with a hint of grapefruit pith in the background. The palate is tangier and more lifted than the nose suggests, with bright flavors of green plum and citrus juice.
title: Cape View 2010 Combination Sauvignon Blanc-Chenin Blanc (Stellenbosch)

description: This is dry, tart and a little one-dimensional, yet elegant, offering red cherry and cola flavors and a wintertime taste of Christmas persimmons. Drink now.
title: Chamisal Vineyards 2010 Estate Bottled Pinot Noir (Edna Valley)

description: Exhibiting the roundness of the vintage, this is rich and soft. With notes of almond, yeast and yellow fruit, this is already maturing into a bold, open wine. Ready to drink.
title: Château Philippe-le-Hardi 2009 En Vesvau  (Saint-Aubin)

description: Soft, full and very rounded, this has yellow fruit flavors that are ripe and open, with its acidity emerging slowly. The finish is more focused and fresh.
title: Château Philippe-le-Hardi 2010  Mercurey

description: Picture perfect Gewürz, this is crisp and incredibly flavorful, with notes of grapefruits, Asian pears and tropical fruits, exotic spices, wild honeysuckle and vanilla. While the label says it's dry, it's rich in honey and butter flavors.
title: Claiborne & Churchill 2011 Dry Gewurztraminer (Central Coast)

description: Earthier aspects mix with the fleshy yellow-plum notes on nose and palate. The medium-sweetness puts the ripeness of the fruit center stage, countered by hints of pith and freshness. Drink soon.
title: Jean-Marc Bernhard 2015 Vieilles Vignes Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Upfront, ripe pear fruit plays on nose and palate. These fruit notes are boosted by slight residual sweetness that makes this wine off dry, counterbalanced by a pleasantly bitter pith note. Enjoy this with ripe, runny cheese for a successful combination.
title: Joseph Fritsch 2015 Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Oaky aromas of baked apple and toasted wood are upfront on the nose of this wine, but are grounded by ample ripe peach, apple flesh and orange. The medium-weight palate is lushly textured and slightly round in feel, though ample acidity helps to keep the flavors fresh and vibrant through the spicy finish.
title: La Forge Estate 2015 Chardonnay (Pays d'Oc)

description: Copper-orange-pink in color, this wonderfully summery wine offers tart citrus and gravelly minerality, a taste of wet stone coated in just the right amount of sweetness.
title: La Pitchoune 2015 Vin Gris of Pinot Noir (Sonoma Coast)

description: This wine is pale peach in color. It starts with aromas of strawberry, herb and spice that lead to juicy, just-off-dry, well-balanced fruit flavors that provide a whole lot of appeal.
title: L'Ecole No. 41 2015 Alder Ridge Vineyard Rosé Grenache (Horse Heaven Hills)

description: Chunky aromas of peach and melon are briny and pickled. With high acidity maintaining shape, there's pinch to the palate. Typical Elqui Valley flavors of mustard and briny apple finish full, viscous and muscular, with a pickled citrus aftertaste.
title: San Pedro 2015 1865 Single Vineyard Chardonnay (Elqui Valley)

description: Spicy, minty aromas and rich flavors like dark chocolate and black cherries add up to a bold, full-bodied wine from the Lange Twins. It has a deep color, moderate tannins to add grip to the texture and a lingering finish.
title: Sand Point 2013 Merlot (Clarksburg)

description: This blends 51% Merlot with 29% Zinfandel, 15% Petit Verdot and 5% Petite Sirah, combining nicely for a full-bodied expression of chocolate and dried dark cherry. On the palate, it becomes dusty and somewhat rustic, with an intensely juicy finish.
title: Sean Minor 2013 Nicole Marie Red (Napa Valley)

description: A vein of burnt sugar threads curiously from nose to finish in this dry full-bodied Pinot Gris. Sunny tangerine, pineapple and apricot flavors flood the midpalate, brightened by streak of lime acidity. A graceful balance of brawn and restraint, it should drink well through 2021.
title: Sheldrake Point 2015 Estate Bottled Pinot Gris (Finger Lakes)

description: Deep golden-yellow in the glass, this wine offers honeyed, candied aromas of mango, crystallized vanilla and golden raisin. It's thick and unctuous on the palate, with more honey, spun sugar, honeysuckle and fruit-nectar flavors that are delicious, but would be aided by a boost of acidity.
designation: R&V Sleepy Hollow Vineyard Late Harvest
title: Talbott 2012 R&V Sleepy Hollow Vineyard Late Harvest Riesling (Santa Lucia Highlands)

description: Mineral, dried peach, lees and honeysuckle aromas lead to just off-dry flavors. Racy acidity frames it nicely.
title: Tempus Cellars 2014 Evergreen Vineyard Riesling (Ancient Lakes)

description: Lemony freshness meets earthy, textured glints on this slender Riesling characterized by its brightness and slender body. Underneath it all, plenty of tart, refreshing apple fruit leads to a clean, lively finish.
title: Vieil Armand 2014 Tradition Riesling (Alsace)

description: Earthy cherry and cassis aromas are backed by bacon and generic gritty scents. This Maule Malbec feels chunky, while salty plum and oaky flavors finish with notes of hickory, savory meat and controlled heat.
title: Viña el Aromo 2012 Private Reserve Malbec (Maule Valley)

description: Notes of freshly peeled red apples are inviting and continue on the soft, rounded and generous palate. It has a lovely midpalate mouthfeel and drinks just off dry, with an accent of vanilla and the merest touch of cinnamon.
title: W. Gisselbrecht 2015 Tradition Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Soft notes of honeysuckle adorn mandarin and clementine fruit. The off-dry palate is richer than the nose suggests and its residual sweetness boosts the full-fruited, peachy nature of the wine. It finishes warm, but zesty and citrus-flavored.
title: Wolfberger 2015 Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Black-cherry and currant flavors are concentrated but restrained in this full-bodied Bordeaux-style blend. Smoky, woody and a bit savory in style, it's abundantly oaky but should balance out neatly from 2020. Bold tannins and brisk acidity mark the finish.
title: Wölffer 2013 Fatalis Fatum Red (Long Island)

description: This is a rich dense wine, full of blackberry fruits. With its firm tannins behind ripe fruitiness, it has fresh acidity and layers of wood to give extra density. The wine is still maturing and should be ready from 2018.
title: Château Tour des Gendres 2015 Tour des Gendres Red (Bergerac)

description: Produced in clay amphoras from organically grown grapes, this is an almost honeyed wine even though it's dry. It is richly textured and ripe, with floral and bitter spice tones. Enjoy from 2017.
title: Clos Troteligotte 2014 K-Libre 1040 Chenin Blanc (Côtes du Lot)

description: Forward and fruity yet balanced and composed, this bold red blend is made from a kitchen's sink blend of Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Malbec, Cabernet Sauvignon, Petit Verdot and Syrah. Luscious black-cherry and plum flavors are ripe but keep a shade short of jammy and are highlighted by a bright vein of acidity. Bold, dense tannins on the finish should meld nicely by 2020.
title: Clovis Point 2013 Archeology Red (North Fork of Long Island)

description: This is an impressively rich wine for a simple Beaujolais. It has plenty of fruit, while it also has a good depth with ripe red-berry fruits and some well-integrated tannins.
title: Collin-Bourisset 2015  Beaujolais

description: Briny lemon-lime aromas come with a note of scrambled egg, which is not uncommon for Cava. Fresh and easy across the palate, this tastes of lettuce, dried apple, white pepper and salty brine. A dry, lightly salty finish maintains integrity.
title: Conde de Subirats NV Cava Brut Sparkling (Cava)

description: This blend of 60% Syrah and 40% Cabernet Sauvignon offers fresh blackberries on cold slate and a light herbal character with dill, oregano and tarragon. A minty quality carries into the sip, where black plum, pepper dust and light tar show.
title: Cooper-Garrod 2011 Test Pilot Red (Santa Cruz Mountains)

description: This is a ripe, smooth blend of Alvarinho and Chardonnay. The two complement each other well with yellow fruits touched by a more citrus edge and a rich character. It is fruity, full-bodied and ready to drink.
title: DFJ Vinhos 2015 Point West White (Lisboa)

description: Named after the Portuguese word for the sommelier's tastevin, the wine is rich with juicy red fruits. It has a firm structure that emphasizes the wine's youth showing that it should develop. Densely textured at the end, the wine will be ready to drink from 2017.
title: DFJ Vinhos 2015 Scancio Reserva Touriga Nacional-Syrah Red (Lisboa)

description: A structured and concentrated wine that is packed with tannins. It does have some black fruit under this dry structure although the wine misses out on richness. It will be ready to drink from 2017.
designation: Réserve Louis Leyre-Loup Le Regard de l'Ange
title: Domaine de Leyre-Loup 2013 Réserve Louis Leyre-Loup Le Regard de l'Ange  (Morgon)

description: There are some fine, dry tannins in this wine along the dark cherry fruit and acidity. It comes from a single vineyard part of the 61-acre estate of Jean-Paul Dubost. There is a ripe feeling here; drink this balanced wine now.
title: Domaine Dubost 2015 Climat le Tracot  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: At the time of tasting, the nose of this dry white was still quite closed, but its buoyant, almost tropical, expressions of mango, cantaloupe and stone fruit on the palate were already quite irresistible. Penetrating and juicy, it wraps up elegantly with a zesty mineral finish. Drink through 2018 to enjoy its fresh, fruity style.
title: Dr. Konstantin Frank 2015 Pinot Gris (Finger Lakes)

description: Clean, reserved citrus and ocean-influenced aromas set up a zesty palate with a common mix of tangerine, lime and green-herb flavors. A lasting finish with peppery snap helps this along.
title: Espiritu de Chile 2015 Winemaker's Collection Sauvignon Blanc (Leyda Valley)

description: Amidst layers of bramble, toast, cedar and herb, bright raspberry and blackberry flavors penetrate throughout this full-bodied Cab Franc. Equal parts fruity and savory, it suggests nuances of beet and soil without being earthy or vegetal. Sunny cranberry acidity and whispery tannins lend a soft, easy frame.
title: Fjord 2014 Cabernet Franc (Hudson River Region)

description: Honeycomb and a fruit basket of melon and berry ride a wave of medium acidity and mellowed sweetness, with a touch of green apple. This is a good call for morning Mimosas.
title: Frank Family 2012 Blanc de Blancs Chardonnay (Carneros)

description: Cleanliness is a fleeting quality on this rosé, which smells compromised and artificial. A modest palate feel and dry, hollow, mostly fruitless flavors lead to a bland finish.
title: Sierra Cantabria 2015 Rosé (Rioja)

description: This young, citrus flavored wine is crisp and still with its yeasty and fruity flavors. The wine is fresh and ready to drink.
title: Quinta do Casal Branco 2015 Lobo e Falcão (Wolf and Falcon) White (Tejo)

description: This is a rustic wine with very ripe fruit that gives a red jelly flavor. It is simple, with a dry edge and acidity, ready to drink now.
title: Solar de Cambres 2014 Casa de Cambres Colheita Red (Douro)

description: Perhaps made in a light-bodied style, this wine comes off as herbal and a touch green, with a dullness on the palate. Aged in 30% new French oak, it takes on a taste of coffee bean that intrigues.
title: Apsara 2014 Las Madres Vineyard Syrah (Carneros)

description: This is a light wine that has crisp, perfumed red fruits and layers of acidity. It is juicy and spicy and finishes with good acidity and a mineral texture. Drink now.
title: J. Portugal Ramos 2015 Smart Dog Syrah-Trincadeira Red (Alentejano)

description: This is a wine that has tannins as well as crisp red-currant fruit. It is lightly textured with a bright shot of acidity. The aftertaste is fresh and lively.
title: Jean-Claude Debeaune 2015 Special Selection  (Beaujolais)

description: Apple and spice aromas come in front of a soft palate. Melony flavors are short on zest and finish abruptly.
title: Vilarnau NV Brut Reserva Sparkling (Cava)

description: Made from Pinot Noir, this is an orange-tan color and offers dried, oxidized aromas of orange and tangerine. Foamy and coarse on the palate, with a sour-orange flavor, it finishes without much verve.
title: Bodegas Hispano Suizas 2013 Tantum Ergo Brut Nature Rosé Sparkling (Cava)

description: Yeasty, candied aromas rest in front of a foamy palate that lacks polish. This tastes like 7-Up and fresh grass, with sweet, yeasty, green-herb flavors that dissipate quickly on the finish.
title: Cavas Hill NV 1887 Brut Sparkling (Cava)

description: This light-weight, easygoing wine offers subtle notes of red cherry, plum and currant on the nose and mouth. A hint of fresh mint adds a touch of interest to the nose. Drink now.
title: Château de Jonquieres 2015 Cuvée Cersius Rosé (Languedoc)

description: Mulchy aromas are not uncommon for rosé from Penedès. This feels full, pulpy and citrusy, with fleshy weight. Orange and grapefruit flavors finish quick.
title: Destello NV Reserva Rosé Sparkling (Penedès)

description: This banana-flavored wine is soft and gently fruity. It has crisp acidity as well as a light tangy texture. Drink now.
title: Domaine de Thulon 2015  Beaujolais-Villages

description: Delicate scents of white flowers and fresh herbs frame the core notes of green apple and lime zest. Refreshing and easy drinking, ample acidity lifts the melon pith and citrus peel flavors that flesh out the medium-weight palate, finishing clean yet short.
designation: Paul Mas Estate Single Vineyard Collection
title: Domaines Paul Mas 2015 Paul Mas Estate Single Vineyard Collection  (Picpoul de Pinet)

description: Simple cherry aromas with notes of cinnamon and chlorinated pool open this light-colored but blocky Pinot Noir. It tastes salty and sweet, with generic plum and red-fruit flavors. Very little flavor stands out on a bland finish.
title: Finca Patagonia 2014 Reserve Pinot Noir (Maule Valley)

description: This semi-sweet Cava boasts a mostly neutral nose. On the palate, it feels like flat soda, with candied lemon-lime flavors that finish lightly oxidized and wheaty.
title: Carbó NV Semi Seco Sparkling (Cava)

description: Earth and spice make for a nice entry and flavor profile into this wine. However it becomes thin and somewhat diluted on the palate.
title: Director's Cut 2014 Pinot Noir (Sonoma Coast)

description: This organic wine was made without added preservatives. After swampy aromas, the flavors are nicely fruity and herbaceous, with a light-medium body and a clean finish.
title: Our Daily Red 2014 Red (California)

description: This wine has a flabby quality that takes away some of its complexity, showing a mix of flavors that lean into green olive and sour lemon.
title: Naggiar 2014 Della Casa Chardonnay (Sonoma County)

description: Aromas of juniper and green herbs are raw and austere. This cool-climate Cab Franc is severe in feel, with tart currant, oak and green flavors. Hard tannins, spice notes and herbaceous red-fruit flavors control the finish.
title: Loma Larga 2012 Unfiltered Cabernet Franc (Casablanca Valley)

description: The wine has structured fruit along with red berry flavors. It is otherwise soft, easy, and ready to drink with a crisp finish.
title: Quinta Monteiro de Matos 2014 Terras de Paul Red (Tejo)

description: The nose gives almost nothing away, while the palate discloses only a little pear fruit, boosted by some residual sweetness that makes this wine off dry. It has a gentle, easy charm. Drink soon.
title: Domaine Fritz Schmitt 2015 Affenberg Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Faint aromas suggest white gumdrop. This feels flat, with flavors of spicy, yeasty apple and a soft, fleeting finish.
title: Mas Fi NV Brut Sparkling (Cava)

description: Bland white-fruit aromas are a bit oily and gritty. This has a watery feel and mildly bitter flavors of white grapefruit, the skin included
title: Finca Patagonia 2015 Expedicion Sauvignon Blanc (Maule Valley)

description: Dusty peppercorn and a green note of cedar define this simple, somewhat diluted effort that's light bodied and lacking in complexity.
title: Venture Wines 2012 Cabernet Sauvignon (Napa Valley)

description: This copper colored rosé is a touch flat, with notes of mushy red berries and melon rind that are hit with a minty accent. The palate is zippy and lifted by ample acidity, though there's a noticeable sweetness to the ripe-fruit flavors.
title: WYSIWYG 2015 Rosé (Pays d'Oc)

description: Vague tropical fruit aromas give way to a petrol note. High in acid but even higher in sugar, this offers flavors of orange and lime that finish fast.
title: Freixenet NV Cordon Negro Sweet Cuvée Sparkling (Cava)

description: This is a soft wine just lightly fruity and with a spicy texture. It is ready to drink.
title: Casa Batoreu 2015 Arinto (Tejo)

description: This brut nature is citric and bubbly on the palate after opening with aromas of weeds and spring onion. Flavors of lemon, herbs, onion and mustard coalesce in front of a bitter finish.
title: Mas Fi NV Brut Nature Reserva Sparkling (Cava)

description: While this wine is dry, its warm strawberry fruit rounds out its character with a softness. Lemon sherbet acidity gives another touch of almost sweetness. Drink now.
title: Roquevale 2015 Ossa Rosé (Alentejano)

description: This is briny, earthy and pickled on the nose, while the foamy palate offers peach and orange flavors that finish pithy.
title: Mas Fi NV Brut Rosé Trepat (Cava)

description: Here's a delicious dessert wine made with dried Moscato grapes. It has an intense fragrance of orange blossoms, citrus and herbs. The dense palate delivers honey, lemon drop, sage and mint. Pair this with cream-filled pastries or fruit tarts.
title: Maculan 2012 Dindarello Moscato (Veneto)

description: This is the finest of the winery's three new rosés, and kudos to them for specializing in blush. The vineyard is in the Green Valley, and the wine shows long hangtime raspberry and cherry fruit, brightened with crisp acidity. It all leads to a dry, spicy finish, and the alcohol is a refreshingly low 13.2% by volume.
designation: Dellinger Vineyard Rosé of Pinot Noir
title: Ousterhout 2012 Dellinger Vineyard Rosé of Pinot Noir Rosé (Russian River Valley)

description: This is a ripe, full and fruity wine that is typical Savigny with its warm red fruits and gentle tannins. It's a rounded, already attractive wine that's full of strawberry and bilberry flavors. It can be drunk now– 2019.
title: Patrick Javillier 2011 Patrick Javillier  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: This is the most balanced of the winery's many 2011 Zins. It's also half the price of the vineyard designates. With raspberry, cherry and cola flavors set in a flurry of spices, it doesn't have the massive overripeness of the others. But that's exactly why it's a more appealing and food-friendly wine.
title: Peachy Canyon 2011 Westside Zinfandel (Paso Robles)

description: Made with Sangiovese, Locorosso has an intense fragrance of wild cherry and underbrush accented by tobacco and spice. The palate is dense and delicious, delivering black cherry layered with carob, coffee and white pepper notes. It's already enjoyable so drink soon.
title: Pratesi 2011 Locorosso Sangiovese (Toscana)

description: This Merlot is round, soft and mellow, with ripe, luscious flavors of cherry pie, mocha, honey and toasty oak, along with a hint of spice. Considering the large production of 36,000 cases and the price, it's quite an achievement.
title: Rutherford Hill 2010 Merlot (Napa Valley)

description: A wine strong in personality and yet restrained in taste, rich in green olives, violets and herbs, surrounded by soft tannins and earthy black pepper. Structured, age this baby for 3–7 years and the herbal character should refine in wonderful ways, the texture only get softer.
title: Steven Kent 2010 Small-Lot Offering Ghielmetti Vineyard Cabernet Franc (Livermore Valley)

description: A rare Champagne made only from red grapes, this dry wine is marked by an intense acidity that needs time to soften. At the moment, lemon flavor dominates, but with time, the crispness of fruit should round out. It's a wine that should age for many years. Drink from 2015.
designation: Cuvée Garance Blanc de Rouges Brut Millesimé
title: Thiénot 2006 Cuvée Garance Blanc de Rouges Brut Millesimé  (Champagne)

description: The winery's 13th release of its flagship Tempranillo has notes of red fruit, savory spices and chocolaty oak accents (95% French, 20% new). The fruit flavors are soft with a velvety texture, surrounded by tightly coiled tannins and tart acidity.
title: Abacela 2009 Estate Grown Tempranillo (Umpqua Valley)

description: Spiced cranberry fruit highlights this tightly-wound young Pinot Noir. Some hard raspberry candy flavors continue through the mid-palate, with chewy acidity leading into a tight, tangy finish.
title: Adelsheim 2011 Bryan Creek Vineyard Pinot Noir (Chehalem Mountains)

description: Quite tart when it hits the lips, this is nonetheless a dense, flavorful Pinot Gris, tasting of grapefruit, sour orange, apple and green banana. It shows lots of juice and powers through the mid-palate into a fruit-driven finish.
title: Adelsheim 2012 Pinot Gris (Willamette Valley)

description: Made from organically grown grapes, this sparkling wine offers a delicate fragrance of white flowers. The palate delivers tropical fruit, white peach, toasted almond and vanilla flavors, and a hint of oak. The frothy palate is supported by fresh acidity.
title: Barone Pizzini 2009 Satèn Chardonnay (Franciacorta)

description: Bellavista's Gran Cuvée Brut offers a pretty floral fragrance of acacia, orange blossom and beeswax. The creamy palate delivers intense honey flavors, along with citrus and toasted almond nuances. It finishes on a crisp, dry note.
title: Bellavista 2007 Gran Cuvée Brut Sparkling (Franciacorta)

description: This crisp, delicate Blanc de Blancs is full of white fruit, but steely and citrusy on the palate. Taut, tight and complex with a layered acidity, this is a nervy, textured wine. Although it is ready to drink now, a few more months in the bottle will make it even better.
title: Jean-Noël Haton NV Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: One of the most familiar of Champagnes, the Yellow Label is finely made—a fruity while structured wine. It has both fresh and fragrant fruit as well as richness, a soft, creamy texture and bright acidity. There is no sense in bottle aging here—drink this wine because of its crispness.
title: Veuve Clicquot Ponsardin NV Yellow Label Brut  (Champagne)

description: A big, ripe and spicy wine that is full of red fruit notes and gentle tannins. It is open and accessible, its fruit juiciness already a pleasure to taste. There is fresh acidity on the finish. Drink now through 2019.
title: Wines & Winemakers 2011 Companhia das Lezírias Catapereiro Escolha Red (Tejo)

description: This Tuscan Syrah opens with aromas of black pepper, plum, blackberry and spice notes with whiffs of vanilla and toasted oak. This is a big brooding wine, with primary blueberry and blackberry flavors accompanied by clove, pepper and enveloping tannins.
title: I Giusti e Zanza 2011 Perbruno Syrah (Toscana)

description: The Vila Santa Reserva boasts wood aging as well as lush, rich fruitiness. The touch of woody spice emphasizes the green- and white-fruits that give this rounded wine a full texture. There is a plush feel that promises some aging, although the wine can be enjoyed now.
title: J. Portugal Ramos 2012 Vila Santa Branco Reserva White (Alentejano)

description: Ripe and soft with rich apple flavor, there's a fullness to this wine. While elegant with a touch of maturity from bottle ageing, the palate is freshened a crispness and levity characteristic of the house style. It has enough weight to accompany food and is ready to drink now.
title: Canard-Duchêne NV Cuvée Léonie Brut  (Champagne)

description: Rubber and wet cement are elements of this wine's smooth bouquet. In the mouth, lifted acidity cuts through a creamy, oaky texture, while flavors of plum, raspberry, red currant, vanilla and oak finish with lactic notes and pastry flavors. In many ways this blend of Cabernet Sauvignon and Carmenère is like ripe, modern Bordeaux.
title: Casa Donoso 2011 1810 Cabernet Sauvignon-Carmenère (Maule Valley)

description: A big, generous wine that is full of rich berry and juicy black plum fruits. It has spice and solid tannins from both the fruit and wood aging, dense and with a good depth of flavor. The acidity and the tannins both promise aging. Drink from 2016.
title: Casca Wines 2009 Cape Roca Lighthouse Red (Douro)

description: This lovely sparkling wine from northern Italy opens with a refined perlage of small, persistent bubbles. The fragrance offers hints of yellow apples and a whiff of bread crust. There is nice length and it finishes on an almond note.
title: Cembra NV Ororosso Extra Brut Sparkling (Trento)

description: This is a successful off-dry Champagne emphasizing fruitiness balanced comfortably with acidity. It showscases rich creamed apple and pear alongside a deep citrus element. A great accompaniment for salads, soft cheeses and seafood.
title: Chanoine NV Tsarine Demi-Sec  (Champagne)

description: Still dominated by its new wood aromas, this is a fine, structured wine that is only just setting out. It has fine weight, rich blackberry fruits and dark tannins. The spicy wood still needs to integrate, so drink from 2017.
title: Château Bel-Air Ortet 2010  Saint-Estèphe

description: A ripe, soft, generous wine, laden with blackberry fruits as well as spice from wood aging. Rich and full-bodied, it has power and concentration from dark tannins as well as the ripe, opulent black fruits of the vintage. Drink from 2014.
title: Château Siaurac 2009  Lalande de Pomerol

description: Cabernet Sauvignon in the cool Lisboa region has a similarity to Bordeaux. It gives a structured, black currant flavored wine, with firm tannins, a mineral texture and serious acidity. The wine is tight and should age well. Drink from 2014.
title: Companhia das Quintas 2010 Quinta de Pancas Cabernet Sauvignon (Lisboa)

description: This is an elegant, smooth wine that draws out the freshness of the vintage as much as the fruitiness. It has ripe, soft tannins, juicy red-fruit flavors and an intriguing smokiness. With acidity holding the wine in check, it should age well. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine Jean Monnier et Fils 2011 Montrevenots Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: This cuvée is billed as the “little sister” to the winery's Evenstad Reserve, and the flavors fit the title. There is a pleasing roundness and an immediate accessibility, with flavors of red fruit and light chocolate in the foreground. Brambly berries are at the core, with highlights of malted milkshake, spice and a hint of finishing citrus.
title: Domaine Serene 2010 Yamhill Cuvée Pinot Noir (Willamette Valley)

description: Here's a structured and spicy Barbera with an enticing fragrance of black fruits, white pepper and exotic spices. The palate is round and smooth, delivering a tight core of black cherry along with black pepper, cinnamon, mint and thyme. It's delicious now, but thanks to refreshing acidity will also stand the test of time. Drink now through 2020.
title: Elio Grasso 2010 Vigna Martina  (Barbera d'Alba)

description: This bottling by Foxen has been consistent over the years in producing a wine of great varietal purity. The 2012 vintage is a dry, crisply mouthwatering wine with gooseberry, grapefruit and peach flavors. Goat cheese comes to mind as the ideal pairing, perhaps in a salad of bitter greens and grapefruits.
title: Foxen 2012 7200 Vogelzang Vineyard Sauvignon Blanc (Happy Canyon of Santa Barbara)

description: This Cabernet blend is one of Baja's best reds. Cured meat, dry spice and brandied berry aromas lead to an elegant (by Baja standards) palate with herbal hints, plenty of spice, solid cherry and berry flavors, and modest tannins. This wine has guts and delivers the goods; contains 18% Merlot and 10% Petit Verdot. Drink through 2020.
title: Monte Xanic 2010 Gran Ricardo Red (Valle de Guadalupe)

description: A rich, opulent Cabernet, made in the modern style. It's firm in tannins and dense with blackberry, currant, olive, dark chocolate and new oak flavors, but is really too young to drink now. Give it at least 6–8 years.
title: Bacio Divino 2010 Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon (Napa Valley)

description: This wine is dry, rich and tannic, showing true Napa elegance. It's rich and savory, with black and red cherry, red currant, licorice and mocha flavors. Provides beautiful drinking now and over the next year or two.
title: Black Stallion 2010 Merlot (Napa Valley)

description: This Cartizze expression of Prosecco Superiore shows gorgeous fullness and softness with pretty layers of peach, nectarine and dry talc powder. The sparkler is smooth and creamy and renders a generous and soft feeling in the mouth.
title: Bortolotti NV Dry  (Valdobbiadene Superiore di Cartizze)

description: The label made from cork adds a curiosity value to this big, firmly tannic wine. With its weight, considerable structure and chunky black fruits, it's definitely a wine to age. Give it 5–6 years.
title: Caves Aliança 2009 Quinta da Dôna Red (Bairrada)

description: This is a fine, impressive Cabernet that shows the soft tannins and slight herbaceousness of Alexander Valley, yet is rich in cherry jam, cassis liqueur, chocolate and sweet oak flavors. Feels plush and fancy in the mouth. Drink soon.
title: Dewitt 2010 Cabernet Sauvignon (Alexander Valley)

description: Already harmonious, this is a potentially opulent wine with a dry core surrounded by ripe red cherry and berry fruit. At the end, the spice adds a fuller note.
title: Domaine du Comte Liger-Belair 2011 Aux Cras Premier Cru  (Nuits-St.-Georges)

description: Firm in tannins, but bright with cherry fruits, this has lovely youthful acidity. Firmer tannins promise good aging over the next 4–5 years.
title: Domaine du Comte Liger-Belair 2011 La Colombière  (Vosne-Romanée)

description: With a heady bouquet of berry and peppery spice, new Edmeades winemaker Ben Salazar is showing great talent with Mendocino Zinfandel, producing a fairly large-scale bottling full of intense spice and soft tannins. Graham crackers and oak play gingerly in the background. This is a wonderful wine and a new beginning for Edmeades.
title: Edmeades 2010 Zinfandel (Mendocino County)

description: A symbolic expression of Italian winemaking, this blend of five grapes (Montepulciano, Primitivo, Sangiovese, Negroamaro and Malvasia) crosses regional borders and delivers various local wine traditions in a single bottle. The wine is bold, rich and very masculine with huge vanilla oak spice, black cherry and chocolate.
title: Farnese 2009 Edizione Cinque Autoctoni Red (Italy)

description: Pietramora Riserva is a dark and masculine wine with aromas of blackberry, black cherry and plum backed by soft renderings of spice, rum cake and leather. The wine shows nice density that is filling without being heavy.
title: Fattoria Zerbina 2008 Pietramora Riserva  (Sangiovese di Romagna Superiore)

description: The Aveleda estate is the source of the fruit for this dry, delicious Vinho Verde. It's a reference for the food-friendly, lemon and grapefruit style, adding minerality and a taut texture to the forward fruitiness. Drink this summer, or hold for up to six months.
title: Aveleda 2012 Quinta da Aveleda Estate Bottled White (Vinho Verde)

description: A pitch-black color is a good indication of the power and concentration this old-vine Malbec has in store. Aromas of blackberry, fir forest and ink set up an over-the-top-rich palate, with heavy extraction and giant flavors of minty blackberry and chocolate. Pull out the knife and fork to cut through the deep, chocolaty finish. Drink now through 2017.
title: Belasco de Baquedano 2010 Swinto Malbec (Mendoza)

description: With many characteristics of the granite-soil based Dão, this is a dense, mineral and dark fruited wine. It has blackberry and plum-skin fruits as well as a firm, tannic core. Even though it's tightly structured now, it is drinkable, but would benefit from another year's aging.
title: Caves Aliança 2010 Vista Reserva Touriga Nacional (Beiras)

description: Rich and robust with smooth tannins, this Lake County Cabernet tastes deliciously austere, with leather, cedar and earth layered over crisp mountain berry fruit. More like the Xurus 2007 than the 2008, it should age just as gracefully, with its savory nature strengthening over time.
title: Xurus 2009 Sonatina Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon (Lake County)

description: Le Colture is one of the best producers of Prosecco Superiore and this Dry expression spells out why. The wine is soft and layered with pretty nuances of peach, white flower and fresh tangerine. You'll love those drying mineral notes at the end that contrast this sparkler's natural sweetness.
title: Le Colture NV Dry  (Valdobbiadene Superiore di Cartizze)

description: Impenetrably black in color and very tannic, this is a big, aloof Syrah. It's bone dry and hard to appreciate now, with elusive blackberry fruit that surfaces briefly, then disappears into a hard finish. The vineyard is in the cool, damp southern part of the valley. Kudos to Lost Canyon for holding it back this long, but it still needs time. Try after 2016.
title: Lost Canyon 2008 Trenton Station Vineyard Syrah (Russian River Valley)

description: This is a juicy blend of blueberry-swaddled Carignane, Zinfandel and Petite Sirah that's also got cherry and raspberry fruit lurking around the edges. Firm, spicy and delicious, it's an out-of-the-ordinary blend that'll surprise and please, especially alongside Asian-inspired short ribs or anything caramelized.
title: Newsome-Harlow 2010 The Deviant Red (Calaveras County)

description: Pricey for a blush wine, but this is an excellent one, among the best rosés of the year. It's fairly dark in color and full-bodied, but very rich in strawberry and spice flavors, and the finish is smooth and dry.
title: Chiarello Family Vineyards 2012 Chiara Rosé of Zinfandel Rosé (Napa Valley)

description: Another classic Gewürz from this fine winery, their best ever. As the label indicates, it's dry, but has an apparent sweetness, with honey-infused orange, Asian pear and litchee nut flavors, and those fabulous exotic spices that are so unique to the variety.
title: Claiborne & Churchill 2012 Dry Gewürztraminer (Central Coast)

description: The 2010 BlackJack is loaded with tart cranberry and pomegranate fruit flavors. There is a streak of iron and darker notes that come through in earthy, slighted roasted tannins. The complexity is intriguing and adds depth to a rather light vintage.
title: David Hill 2010 Estate BlackJack Pinot Noir (Willamette Valley)

description: You won't find many wines like this on the market today. The blend is Tai grapes with 30% Sauvignon. The bouquet is broad and intense with complex aromas of peach, apricot, cinnamon, passion fruit, toasted almond and butterscotch. In the mouth, the texture is long, creamy and soft.
title: De Stefani 2010 Olmèra White (Veneto)

description: A structured wine, packed with red fruits and delightful acidity. There is a core of dark tannin and a solid structure as well as the bright freshness at the end. Because it has this structure, it's worth aging for 4–5 years.
title: Domaine des Croix 2011  Beaune

description: This wine has great strawberry flavors with soft tannins and sweet fruits. It's fragrant, delicate, and very pure in style, with just a hint of structure and likely to age over the medium term.
title: François Bertheau 2011  Chambolle-Musigny

description: Big, bold and tannic, this is powerful Gamay from La Tour du Bief vineyard in Juliénas. It has weight, and a concentrated texture that bodes well for the wine's future. Along with this structure are the fragrant black and red currant fruits, already delicious to drink.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2011 Clef du Bief  (Moulin-à-Vent)

description: A rich Pouilly Fuissé, concentrating on ripe tropical fruits and a rounded structure. The wine has weight, richness and a good density. With all these complex characters, it's a wine that needs to age over at least three years.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2011 Clos Reyssié  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: Grgich Hills is better known for Chardonnay and Cabernet Sauvignon, but this is really a great Sauvignon Blanc, although they call it Fumé Blanc. The wine is dry, yet enormously flavorful in citrus and tropical fruits, with a mouthwatering, savory hit of green gooseberry followed by creamy, leesy richness.
title: Grgich Hills 2011 Fumé Blanc Estate Grown Dry Sauvignon Blanc (Napa Valley)

description: This excellent wine has good concentration and pretty, fruit-sweet flavors of berry, cherry, and a splash of Dr. Pepper. It brings in elegant details of truffle and more of that pleasant cola character, and lingers through a generous finish.
title: Hawks View 2010 Hawks View Vineyard Pinot Noir (Chehalem Mountains)

description: Like all the wines created by Roccolo Grassi, you can really feel that extra push towards quality and elegance here. La Broia is an oak-aged Soave with a soft consistency and loads of peach, tangerine, melon and white fruit intensity. The finish is smooth and creamy.
title: Roccolo Grassi 2010 La Broia  (Soave)

description: From the celebrated Cartizze cru, this delicate sparkling wine shows delicate tones of talc powder and honey backed by citrus and stone fruit. What sets the wine apart is the elegance and soft perlage it shows overall.
title: Ruggeri & C. NV Dry  (Valdobbiadene Superiore di Cartizze)

description: A nicely made wine at an attractive price, this offers crowd-pleasing elements of juicy black cherry, cassis and cedar around smoky oak and a medium-bodied concentration that remains succulent on the palate.
title: Previous 2012 Merlot (Napa Valley)

description: This wine comes from vines south of the Mont Sainte-Victoire and close to the edge of the Aix-en-Provence region. The cool vineyard site helps the wine keep extreme freshness. Plenty of wild strawberry flavors are lifted by acidity and a refreshing citrus edge.
title: Provence Wine Maker 2015 Rose Infinie Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Coming from two area standouts—Lewis and Phinny Hill vineyards—this wine shows appealing aromas and flavors of shaved coconut, Mounds Bar, cherry and baking spices. The barrel influence is prominent but it largely stands up to it.
title: Pursued by Bear 2012 Baby Bear Syrah (Columbia Valley (WA))

description: This is a simply delicious and assertive wine that smells like roses and lemon zest, tastes like fresh apricots and biscotti and has a tangy, appetizing balance. It will be super as an apéritif for a summer time outdoor dinner.
title: Rivino 2014 Estate Viognier (Mendocino)

description: Voluptuous white peach and lighter butter notes form a classic nose set against a chalky backbone of lemon verbena and pink apple skins. The palate is tightly knit with lime skins, quinine and pink grapefruit pith, proving versatile and tartly acid-driven in style.
title: Roblar 2013 Gold Collection Chardonnay (Sta. Rita Hills)

description: Lush red berry and ripe cherry aromas meet with baked boysenberry pie and a suave vanilla character on the nose of this estate bottling. Earthy tones of graphite, turned loam and dried leather enhance the black cherry base fruit and the tobacco leaf spice.
title: Roblar 2014 Sangiovese (Santa Ynez Valley)

description: A slight note of pear drop plays on the nose. The palate is juicy and vivid with citrus, green pear and some white pepper. Light on its feet, with an energetic force at its core and lovely concentration of citrus and herb notes, this fizzes away pleasantly. This is far too easy to drink and very, very refreshing.
title: Schloss Gobelsburg 2015 Grüner Veltliner (Kamptal)

description: A new effort from Jigar Vineyards, sourcing some very good grapes, Sedition is light, clear and lingering on the palate in cherry-cola, mint and dried herb. Balanced and on the lighter side in terms of body and tannin, it's ready for the table, with a juicy, persistent finish.
title: Sedition 2013 Chenoweth Vineyards Pinot Noir (Russian River Valley)

description: This vibrant, savory white opens with alluring scents of pear, tropical fruit and a whiff of fragrant white flower. The round, medium-bodied palate shows white peach, golden apple and mineral. Fresh acidity brightens the creamy flavors while an almond note backs up the finish.
title: Selva Capuzza 2015 San Vigilio  (Lugana)

description: Lime zest and guava notes make for a tropical nose. The palate adds greener tints of grass and midpalate texture that combines a creamy core with spiky freshness. The concentrated core results in a resonant, clean finish. Not your usual Sauvignon Blanc but one worth trying.
title: Skoff 2013 Obegg Sauvignon Blanc (Südsteiermark)

description: Soft, rounded waves of red plum become succulent on the palate without overwhelming, despite a full-bodied style and personality. A heave of subtle tannin plays out to add body and weight as the wine develops in the glass.
title: St. Francis 2013 Behler Vineyard Merlot (Sonoma Valley)

description: A rather closed nose wants to give little away, but the palate is zingy with yeast, grapefruit peel and fresh, greenish leafiness, all held with focus and poise. Very refreshing.
title: Stadt Krems 2015 Grüner Veltliner (Kremstal)

description: Chocolate, plum and mocha make for an inviting entry to this wine. Cedar and gun flint season a smooth wall of youthful, polished tannin and integrated oak, with a lengthy finish.
title: Starmont 2012 Cabernet Sauvignon (Napa Valley)

description: This lively, elegant white, made with 100% Trebbiano, opens with heady scents of white spring flower and orchard fruit. The vibrant, linear palate delivers white peach, crunchy pear, tangerine and a mineral note. Racy acidity provides balance and generates a crisp, clean finish.
title: Suavia 2013 Massifitti Trebbiano (Veronese)

description: Light and delicate bubblegum aromas are cut by pink lemonade, a touch of honeydew and a peachy ripeness on this blend of 67% Grenache, 22% Picpoul Blanc, 8% Mourvèdre and 3% Syrah. There is lots of minerality on the sip, with rainy slate and wet cement, as well as rounded watermelon, strawberry and bubblegum flavors, all sliced by lime and tangerine zest.
title: Halter Ranch 2015 Rosé (Paso Robles)

description: A tasty tang of toasted oak adds a great top note to this full-flavored and full-bodied wine, so that it seems to build complexity from the bass notes of ripe pear, to the butter and cinnamon in the middle and up to the wrapping of spicy, smoky oak.
title: Harken 2014 Barrel Fermented Chardonnay (California)

description: Smashed berries, honeyed coffee, leather, beef jerky, cola and black pepper show on the nose of this complex wine by the legendary Hearst family. The mouthfeel is medium-bodied, with lightly roasted coffee notes, touches of seared caramel, sesame oil and teriyaki and a base of dried black-plum fruit.
title: Hearst Ranch 2013 Babicora Malbec (Paso Robles)

description: This is a concentrated, dark and brooding wine from the producer's well-known property, sparkling in acidity despite its intensity of weight and length. Blackberry and nutmeg sit atop a soft integration of tannin and oak. Drink now through 2020.
title: Howell Mountain Vineyards 2013 Beatty Ranch Zinfandel (Howell Mountain)

description: From winemaker John Kane, who worked for years with Kent Rosenblum, this wine is dense and decadently rich and concentrated, a jammy, thick flavor explosion of soy sauce, black olive and Dr. Pepper cola. Smooth on the palate, it threatens to overpower in ripeness before pulling back just enough to show complexity.
title: JCK Wine Company 2014 Jack Florence Vineyard Zinfandel (Dry Creek Valley)

description: What a lovely and balanced rendition of Zweigelt: its forest fruit and cherry notes are pure and held in a tight focus on the midpalate. The body is smooth, full-fruited, generous but balanced by vibrant, food-friendly and appetizing freshness. Handled with such bravura, Zweigelt almost attains a Pinot-like elegance—no wonder, since the Reinisch-brothers are masters of their art.
title: Johanneshof Reinisch 2014 Zweigelt (Thermenregion)

description: This wine is not aromatic at first, blossoming slowly into shy layers of red berry and subtle cinnamon before taking on a pleasant juiciness and medium weight. The tannins are non-agressive and integrated into the spicy finish.
title: Kenwood 2013 Six Ridges Zinfandel (Dry Creek Valley)

description: Cocoa, vanilla and baking spice aromas intertwine with cranberry, black licorice, herb and dark fruit on a wine with a very distinctive aromatic profile. The cranberry and cherry flavors are quite soft for the variety, seeming a touch dried out at times but showing a pleasing sense of balance.
title: Kontos 2012 Cabernet Sauvignon (Walla Walla Valley (WA))

description: This is a nicely balanced wine from estate-grown vines, a mix of licorice and raspberry that offers luxurious mouthfeel and texture atop surprising acidity. A small amount of Viognier was used in fermentation to provide some additional lift and floral aromas, while a dustiness prevails on the finish.
title: Kunde 2013 Estate Grown Syrah (Sonoma Valley)

description: Citric force creates a pleasant vortex of green pear on this easy, zippy and full-fruited summer wine. Finishes with a lip-smacking fillip of bracing, lemony freshness. Almost like sherbet.
title: Landhaus Mayer 2015 Grüner Veltliner (Niederösterreich)

description: This rich wine is ripe with red-berry fruits, mango and peach. Full in the mouth, it has a touch of spice from the Mourvèdre in the blend. Crisp and lively, the wine could age until 2018, although it will be best from late 2016.
title: Les Vignobles Gueissard 2015 Cuvée G Rosé (Bandol)

description: Struck flint and tomato stalk on the nose lead into a medium-bodied wine with strong citrus overtones. White grapefruit and green leafy notes linger on the dry finish.
title: Loveblock 2015 Sauvignon Blanc (Marlborough)

description: Stewed strawberries, blackberry jam, maple, brown sugar, black pepper, teriyaki and pork fat show on the lush nose of this bargain bottling. It's soft on the palate, with fruity strawberry and ripe plum flavors, as well as some more serious beef char elements. It's fun, easy and delicious.
title: Maddalena 2014 Zinfandel (Paso Robles)

description: A showy but crisp and fresh style of Chard, this offers honey butter, ripe apple flesh, yellow roses, lemongrass and the slightest show of guava tropicality on the nose. The sip begins with that tropical guava and mango character, then tightens on mandarin orange and lemon rind.
title: Martin Ray 2014 Bald Mountain Vineyard Chardonnay (Santa Cruz Mountains)

description: Red cherry and wild strawberry suggest themselves aromatically. The light body is fresh and equally aromatic, slender, lithe and elegant. This is a very continental, balanced and rounded Pinot Noir, all the more charming for its unfussy, fresh-faced authenticity.
title: Meinklang 2014 Pinot Noir (Burgenland)

description: 2012 marks only the second vintage for winemaker Nathan Kendall, but this dry, exceptionally stony Riesling suggests a promising start already. Fermented spontaneously with indigenous yeast, it's exquisitely spry but concentrated in lime, blossom and white grapefruit notes.
title: N. Kendall Wines 2012 Dry Riesling (Finger Lakes)

description: Lots of heavily toasted oak sits atop the bouquet, and thus it's no surprise that the flavor profile runs a bit lemony and sharp. But give the wine time to unfold and you'll find a layer of pure blackberry mixed with notes of chocolate and coffee. Arguably too oaky but with good core qualities.
title: Valentin Bianchi 2006 Famiglia Bianchi Malbec

description: Two of the crispest and most savory white varieties in California are Sauvignon Blanc and Pinot Gris/Grigio, and this blend of both shows the best qualities of each. It's just slightly off-dry and vibrant in citrus, fig, melon and vanilla flavors, with beautiful acidity.
title: Vision Cellars 2006 Blanc Gris White (California)

description: There's a touch of wood to this wine, but the primary emphasis is on citrusy, pineapple-scented fruit. Apple flavors provide roundness, while the wine finishes citrusy and fresh without being sharp.
title: Andrew Peace 2006 MasterPeace Chardonnay (South Eastern Australia)

description: The Aviator Red is a well-crafted blend that mixes strawberry, raspberry, pepper and stone in an effective balance that seems to draw the best from each grape. For a modest, everyday wine, this works quite well.
title: Airfield Estates 2005 Aviator Red Red (Yakima Valley)

description: This is 100% varietal. It has muscle and mass, with tart purple and black fruits wrapped into layers of earth and slightly metallic tannins. There is a green streak but it adds complexity and is not off-putting. This would be an excellent wine with a simple hanger steak.
title: Arbor Crest 2004 Merlot (Columbia Valley (WA))

description: After almost losing a finger struggling to remove the rock-hard faux wax “capsule” I found this strawberry/cherry cordial-flavored wine quite pleasant. The fruit, from a Rattlesnake Hills vineyard, has a sweet core, while the tannins add an earthy streak of green tea.
title: Basel Cellars 2005 Chelle den Millie Reserve Cabernet Franc (Columbia Valley (WA))

description: Sangiovese (50%) is blended with equal parts Merlot and Cabernet to produce a simple red wine with thin berry fruit aromas, forest berry, floral nuances and some sharp points of bright acidity. Elegance and harmony are the objective and the wine reaches it nicely. It's also an easy wine with good length that would pair easily with all Mediterranean foods.
title: Castello di Corbara 2004 Red Blend Red (Lago di Corbara)

description: Full and confident on the nose, with a wide range of berry aromas. The palate is medium in weight and power, but the flavors are entirely ripe and juicy, with an emphasis on raspberry and plum. Not overpowering but still it shows Chile's ability to produce wall-to-wall red wines at moderate prices.
title: Chilcas 2006 Reserva Syrah (Maule Valley)

description: A scintillating scent of rose petals opens up this pleasing wine, which continues with raspberry and cherry fruit, accented with light milk chocolate. It is not a heavy wine; in fact, if Franc can ever be called elegant, even feminine, this is how it should taste. The finish falls off rather quickly, but otherwise it is a fine effort.
title: Columbia Crest 2005 Beverly Vineyard Reserve Cabernet Franc (Columbia Valley (WA))

description: This pure Cabernet Sauvignon is not a heavy wine, but within its sleek profile are interesting flavors of berry, leaf and earth. Tannins are crisp and proportionate, and the fruit carries through a graceful, moderately long finish.
title: Foundry Vineyards 2005 Artisan Blend Red (Walla Walla Valley (WA))

description: The name means Tank 26. This is a wine offering fresh fruit, a creamy undertow and crispness. The acidity is prominent, with excellent fresh pepper and lime crispness.
title: Tegernseerhof 2006 T26 Frauen Weingarten Grüner Veltliner (Wachau)

description: A deliciously  crisp and fresh wine with some good concentrated fruit, but more attractive acidity. There is just a hint of spice, but freshness is what this wine is all about.
title: Machherndl 2006 Kollmitz Federspiel Riesling (Wachau)

description: This is an easy wine to drink with a soft, generous personality and interesting aromas of red berry fruit backed by dusty minerals and spice. It would pair well with pasta, pork and veal thanks to its no-fuss approach and natural succulence.
title: Madonna Alta 2004  Montefalco Rosso

description: This blend of all the Bordeaux varieties satisfies for its wealth of well-ripened fruit. It just floods the mouth with the flavors of crushed, perfectly ripe blackberries, black raspberries and wild cherries, picked under the warm summer sun. Oak adds smoky nuances. A good job from Madrona. Drink now.
title: Madroña 2004 Reserve Quintet Red (El Dorado)

description: It's amazing how consistently good Lake County Sauvignon Blancs can be at such a good price, and with their '05, Wildhurst exemplifies these qualities. The wine is very ripe in citrus, fig, green melon, vanilla and peppery spice flavors, with wonderful acidity and a honeyed finish.
title: Wildhurst 2006 Reserve Sauvignon Blanc (Lake County)

description: Superripe in blackberry, red plum, cherry, mocha, fig and caramel flavors, this wine certainly scores high on the deliciousness factor. It could use greater structural depth and complexity but is good overall.
title: Addamo 2005 Reserve Syrah (Santa Barbara County)

description: Sweet plum and pie cherry fruit highlights a bright and spicy style. The young vines push all the flavor up front, then hold on for dear life as the midpalate lingers on a note of lightly chocolaty plum. The tannins need some softening; there is a stemmy flavor that slightly mars the finish.
title: Alexandria Nicole 2005 Grenache (Horse Heaven Hills)

description: At first high-toned, this opens nicely with crisp green apple fruit flavors. It's balanced and clear. Don't look for big, blowsy tropical flavors or buttery oak, though the barrel fermentation provides some texture to the finish. A great food wine.
title: Arbor Crest 2005 Conner Lee Vineyard Chardonnay (Columbia Valley (WA))

description: Ripe and crisp in acidity, this 100% Pinot Gris comes from a single vineyard in this highly regarded Santa Barbara County appellation. The wine never saw oak, so the pineapple, apple butter, mango and vanilla flavors come entirely from the grapes.
title: Carr 2006 Turner Vineyard Pinot Gris (Sta. Rita Hills)

description: A lively, open, crisp wine, ready to drink, with a fresh apple and cream flavor complementing its flavors of pineapple and herbaceous edge. Delicious, easy Sauvignon Blanc.
title: Château de Tracy 2006 Mademoiselle de T  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: A solid blast of tropical and green fruits rises from the glass. The palate is sharp and citric at first, and then it opens and evolves to show grapefruit, lemon and tangerine flavors. If you like a crisp, steely style of Sauvignon, then give this refreshing wine a shot.
title: Chilcas 2007 Reserva Sauvignon Blanc (Casablanca Valley)

description: Aromas of citrus peel, rubber, spice, and iodine lead to a tight, drawing but full-feeling palate. This tastes herbal, spicy and oaky, with carob accenting black fruit and berry flavors. A minty, oaky, resiny finish closes this out.
title: Ritual 2013 Alcaparral Syrah (Casablanca Valley)

description: Nuanced rose water, pink grapefruit, ginger and lychee aromas are followed by off-dry fruit flavors and a floral finish. The feel and flavors win you over but the wine wants a little more acid to pull itself together.
title: Sineann 2014 Celilo Vineyard Gewurztraminer (Columbia Gorge (WA))

description: This wine is mostly Viognier (78%) blended with Roussanne. Pear, melon and almond aromas are followed by full-bodied flavors with abundant tangerine and floral accents.
title: Stottle 2013 White (Yakima Valley)

description: Full and weighty, this vineyard-designate is salty and floral, offering whiffs of orange blossom around lime zest and brine. The minerality shines through despite the size, making for a food-friendly, yet hedonistic wine.
title: Tamber Bey 2014 Mello Vineyard Sauvignon Blanc (Yountville)

description: This is a medium-bodied, oak-inflected wine. Initial aromas of sun-warmed lumber and vanilla give way with air to scents of cola, earth and mocha. The overall impression is savory, especially on the long finish, which picks up some asphalt notes. Probably best with herb-crusted beef or lamb.
title: Maimai 2013 Syrah (Hawke's Bay)

description: Stalky, lightly green aromas of tobacco and mountain herbs blend with leathery plum and berry scents in front of a round, full-bodied palate. Loamy, earthy plum flavors come with an herbal covering, while this tastes oaky, herbal and like cocoa on the finish. Drink through 2018.
title: Ochagavia 2013 Gran Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon (Maipo Valley)

description: Few wineries in Central Otago devote much time or energy to Sauvignon Blanc, so it's nice to try one on occasion. This is pungent and boxwood-like on the nose, but the flavors are less aggressive, more white grapefruit and celery stalk. There's ample weight and a crisp, refreshing finish.
title: Peregrine 2014 Sauvignon Blanc (Central Otago)

description: Blended with 20% Sauvignon Blanc, this wine starts out somewhat aromatically brooding, with notes of melon and toast. It brings plenty of texture and richness, with a creamy feel and a warm finish.
title: L'Ecole No. 41 2014 Sémillon (Columbia Valley (WA))

description: Ripe and juicy, this full-bodied wine has black plum and berry fruits that are well integrated into the juicy acidity and ripe tannins. The wine will develop quickly, so drink from late 2016.
title: Les Vignerons Réunis de Monségur 2014 Château Arnaucosse  (Bordeaux)

description: This is a structured wine, displaying black currant and spice notes. Still young, with grippy tannins and a dusty texture, this will develop quickly into a round and fruity wine. Drink from late 2016.
title: Les Vignerons Réunis de Monségur 2014 Château Grand Marchand  (Bordeaux)

description: Slate, plum, red fruits, and baking spices of cinnamon and clove show on the nose of this wine from a longtime vineyard east of Solvang. It's fairly light in body, but with pleasing purple fruit flavors, a touch of coffee and a strong herbal complexity.
title: Lucas & Lewellen 2012 Valley View VIneyard Cabernet Sauvignon (Santa Ynez Valley)

description: There's a touch on barnyard on the nose of this bottling by one of the region's earlier settlers, with aromas of hay and oyster mushrooms adding intrigue to the cranberry fruit. The forest floor and juniper character is strong on the palate, where tart red fruit mixes with pencil lead and bergamot rinds.
title: Manzoni 2013 Home Vineyard Pinot Noir (Santa Lucia Highlands)

description: Merlot and Syrah make up the majority of this blend. Aromas of cherry, coffee, pencil lead and barrel spices are initially light and elusive while the plum and vanilla and flavors are much more generous.
title: Mercer 2013 Sharp Sisters Red (Horse Heaven Hills)

description: Pleasing aromas of butter, spice and apple lead to elegant, creamy-feeling flavors. It's a very tasty, very varietally correct wine.
title: Mercer Canyons 2014 Chardonnay (Columbia Valley (WA))

description: Aromas of ripe dark-skinned fruit and baking spice lead the nose. The palate delivers black cherry, raspberry compote and a hint of ground pepper while close-knit, fine-grained tannins grip the finish.
title: Montevetrano 2013 Core Aglianico (Campania)

description: Very ripe apple aromas mix with light peach and summer melon on the nose of this light and refreshing sipper from the family's Edna Valley property. It's clean and tight on the palate, showing more stone fruit, lime skins and a racy minerality.
title: Niner 2014 Albariño (Edna Valley)

description: Aromas of dried herbs, bittersweet chocolate, coffee and cherry are varietal and lead to abundant woodspice accents. The palate offers lively acidity that frames the lithe yet sweet fruit flavors.
title: North by Northwest 2013 Cabernet Sauvignon (Columbia Valley (WA))

description: Baked plum, blue flower, dark spice, vanilla and dried herb emerge in the glass. The dense, chewy palate offers mature black cherry, raspberry jam, fig and sweet cake spice alongside velvety tannins. It has hit its ideal drinking window so enjoy soon.
title: Nugnes 2009 Caleno Oro Aglianico (Campania)

description: Made with native grapes Aglianico and Piedirosso, this offers aromas of fig, mature plum, vanilla and scorched earth. The ripe, round palate shows dried black cherry, chopped herb, cocoa and a minty note while firm, fine-grained tannins provide support.
title: Nugnes 2011 Caleno Riserva Red (Falerno del Massico)

description: There's welcoming warmth to the nose of this wine, with seared apple and poached pear alongside vanilla cream, brown spice and smoke. The palate is fresh with lemon juice and pink grapefruit, but powered by soft apple fruit and a lot of sea salt.
title: Pace 2014 Chardonnay (Santa Barbara County)

description: Citrus plays with pear notes on a slightly out-of-focus palate. This wine is fresh and very light-bodied with zesty lemon and should be marked for early drinking.
title: Steininger 2014 Grand Grü Reserve Grüner Veltliner (Kamptal)

description: Toast, coffee, vanilla, dill and other wood spices are far out-front on the aromas. They vie for attention on the palate as well, never seeming to marry with the fruit while still providing enjoyment.
title: Stottle 2012 Tempranillo (Columbia Valley (WA))

description: Bright lime skin, grapefruit pith and soda character show on the nose of this tight and clean bottling from the appellation's vanguard vineyard. The sip is all about texture and energy, with pear-skin flavors that are soft but grippy, plus acidity that is strong but never searing.
title: Tangent 2014 Paragon Vineyard Pinot Gris (Edna Valley)

description: Aromas of withered white rose, resin and dried stone fruit mingle with an unusual whiff of paraffin. On the sweet, concentrated palate, orange blossom honey emphasizes the dried apricot and citrus zest.
title: Baglio di Pianetto 2010 Ra'is Moscato (Sicilia)

description: Velvety tannins underlie a concentrated body of menthol, peppercorn, cedar and blackberry, punctuated in coffee along the way. An estate-bottling from one of the appellation's longstanding resident wineries, this wine is bold and brawny.
title: Trentadue 2013 Reserve La Storia Cabernet Sauvignon (Alexander Valley)

description: This wine checks all the Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc boxes. It's medium in weight and ably marries some green, leafy character with white grapefruit notes. The lasting impression is of an herbal grapefruit sorbet that leaves behind a clean, refreshed palate.
title: Greyrock 2014 Reserve Sauvignon Blanc (Marlborough)

description: An element of menthol-cinnamon chewing gum shows on the nose of this wine, grown at high elevations above the Sonoma Valley. High-pitched acidity buoys velvety red fruit, with a clay-like flavor and texture to the tannins.
title: Korbin Kameron 2012 Estate Grown Merlot (Moon Mountain District Sonoma County)

description: Aromas of tire rubber and asphalt are low on fruit. This turns for the better on the palate, which feels creamy despite showing rubbery tannins. Peppery flavors of cherry, plum and raspberry become salty on a mostly smooth, solid finish.
title: Ventisquero 2012 Herú Pinot Noir (Casablanca Valley)

description: Made with organically cultivated fruit, this opens with scents of ripe red berry, dark spice and an earthy whiff of tilled soil. The smooth, easy-drinking palate offers juicy morello cherry, crushed raspberry and a hint of white pepper alongside bright acidity.
title: Vigna di Pettineo 2013 Frappato (Vittoria)

description: Waxy apple and peach open this wine, before deeper hits of vanilla give it a complexity of flavor. Crisp, bright and refreshing, it offers a touch of brine and sour lemon on the finish.
